definition: Valuation of options estimates the value of contingent rights to transact under specified terms by modeling factors such as underlying price, volatility, time, and exercise rules.
entry_text: Valuation of options estimates the value of contingent rights to transact under specified terms by modeling factors such as underlying price, volatility, time, and exercise rules.
example: An analyst compares model prices of otherwise similar options with different expiration dates.
label: Valuation of options
sense_note: Financial derivative sense; other contexts can refer to real options or comparing alternatives.
